tasks.title: Add domain adapter interface
tasks.objective: Allow validated, permission-scoped domain adapters to produce executable checks rather than relying only on recorded evidence.
acceptance: Adapters are isolated from untrusted task text and cannot invoke arbitrary commands
Demonstrate adapters for software, research, and document tasks using negative tests
Preserve evidence digests, separated reviewers, and task ordering

tasks.title: Add authenticated independent review
tasks.objective: Bind independent reviewer identity, candidate identity, and verdict to a trusted host or provider instead of a self-declared actor string.
acceptance: A self-authored or stale verdict cannot close a task
Review identity and candidate binding can be verified from trusted provider data
A failed review blocks closure until a later exact-candidate pass

tasks.title: Run three end-to-end domain pilots
tasks.objective: Prove the common operating contract on a software task, a sourced research task, and a non-code document task.
acceptance: Complete reproducible tasks from each of the three domains
Capture implementation effort, rework, genuine evidence and unresolved limitations
Revise the framework based on demonstrated failures rather than speculative complexity
